title: Elías Pereyra | Fullstack Developer focused on Web & Mobile Frontend
description: I'm Elías Pereyra, a fullstack developer from Argentina focused on web and mobile frontend. Check out my experience, my projects, and how to reach me.

hero.description: I’m Elías Pereyra, a Fullstack Developer focused on web and mobile Frontend.

synkpay.lead: Owned the frontend of a cryptocurrency dashboard and reshaped its architecture so it could keep growing.
synkpay.description: Built features end to end with React, GraphQL APIs and Redux Toolkit. Migrated styling from Styled-components to Tailwind, DaisyUI and CVA, and led the move from a feature-based architecture to a modular monolith of 1,000+ files, with clear module boundaries and fewer cross-dependencies.

keywallet.lead: Built the security flows of a mobile crypto wallet, as one of three frontend engineers.
keywallet.description: With Expo and Tamagui, implemented password and biometric login, inactivity lock and re-authentication for sensitive actions. Also built in-app notifications on an event-driven architecture, and fixed navigation with Expo Router so going back works reliably even when a screen is reachable from several places.

octaflow.lead: Built, together with another developer, the infrastructure that coordinates AI agents on an AI-assisted engineering platform.
octaflow.description: Project context, task planning and execution, harnesses and verification workflows so agents deliver complete features reliably. Also built the Profile component from scratch.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.author: Author:
contributions.first: I worked as a translator and technical content reviewer for freeCodeCamp en Español, on articles and handbooks about web development and programming. I translated more than 40 pieces of different lengths and complexity, from introductions to basic concepts to documentation on more specific technical topics.
contributions.second: My goal was to bring quality technical content to people who aren't fluent in English yet, or who simply prefer reading in Spanish. The idea was for everything the freeCodeCamp community builds in English to also reach the Spanish-speaking community.

about.title: About me
about.first: I’m Elías Pereyra Gómez, a developer from Argentina. I enjoy turning ideas into things that actually work and feel good to use.
about.second: I mostly work on web and mobile frontend, but I like understanding how every piece of an application fits together, not just what users see. That's why I also enjoy backend work and building complete systems, end to end.
about.third: I care about the details in the UI: I lean on the fundamentals of interface design and enjoy building design systems that are consistent and easy to extend, like the one I migrated to Tailwind + CVA.
about.fourth: I'm looking to join a product team where I can contribute on the frontend, learn from experienced people, and keep growing. If that sounds like your team, drop me a line.

contact.title: Let's build something.
contact.subtitle: Open to frontend and fullstack roles.

turnos.first-paragraph: An app for booking doctor appointments without phone calls or waiting: patients enter their details once, request an appointment, and get an SMS when the doctor confirms it. On the other side, an admin manages patients and appointments from a dashboard.
turnos.second-paragraph: This type of system helps streamline the process of booking an appointment with a doctor. It saves waiting time for patients, provides basic information in advance, and speeds up the appointment management process for doctors and medical resources.
turnos.third-paragraph: The system is developed with Next.js and Appwrite (a BaaS - cloud-based service). The pages and components were designed in Figma.
turnos.solved: credentials that never reach the browser, long forms validated instantly, and an admin panel that confirms or cancels appointments with an SMS notice.

workstart.first-paragraph: A job board for landing your first job in Argentina, no sign-up needed: pick an opening and email the company directly. Every listing shows the province, work mode, and schedule up front.
workstart.second-paragraph: Applying directly to the company saves a lot of time and helps personalize the contact. Additionally, each job listing displays key details such as salary, work mode, schedule, responsibilities, and benefits. The platform is designed so that these details are mandatory for posting job openings.
workstart.third-paragraph: The system is built with Next.js and Sanity as a headless CMS, using GROQ queries and live content updates. User accounts run on Better Auth (email and password or passkeys) backed by a PostgreSQL database on Neon, and tests are written with Vitest and Testing Library. The pages and components were designed in Figma.
workstart.solved: listings published from a CMS without touching code, direct applications with no account, and tests on search filters and favorites.

product.title: Web products, end to end
product.text: I design in Figma, build with Next.js and wire up the backend: headless CMS, passkey auth, PostgreSQL or a BaaS. WorkStart and DocHeal are live, so you can try them.

quality.title: Quality & testing
quality.text: I test components the way people use them, with Testing Library and user-event, and add unit tests with Vitest or Jest and end-to-end tests with Playwright.
